t: You attend a meeting that could have been an email. It spawns two more meetings.
Someone microwaves fish in the kitchen. The building unites in silent grief.
You reply-all by accident. Nobody notices. This time.
You alt-tab from a spreadsheet to a different, equally bleak spreadsheet.
The office plant judges you silently. You water it as tribute.
Quiet hour. Actual work occurs. Historians will dispute this.
You help a coworker un-mute. You are briefly a god.
Free cake in the kitchen for someone’s birthday. You do not know them. You eat the cake.
The aircon sets itself to "meat locker". Productivity somehow rises.
You clear 30 emails. 31 arrive. The sea refuses no river.
